name: verification-integration
goal: The branch preserves cold public API imports, canonical planning references and decoded design images while enforcing component evidence and task completion.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The broad committed run exposes a cold public API import of an undeclared Svelte compiler, planning references filtered by helper display rules, and design URLs revoked before their DOM image detaches. Existing tests demonstrate these failures. Retired private functions also lost historical detail routes because active-only fallback omitted their proven first-parent contract.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Packed-consumer, project-run-references and image-url standardized coverage already owns these paths. Extend it with actual exported plan auditing, a canonical registry assertion and a DOM-safe release assertion; preserve browser error collection. EntityFrame coverage omitted retired private functions; add active, retired and unrelated-parent variants while asserting collection exclusion.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 8eb5477ec298158655f1ecb6c4184d57127af3c338cb801a81d204e98e0733bd at 11b40b3a reproduces the cold package import, missing private planning reference, early image release and seven-category mobile overflow using the standardized tests.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Bundle undeclared compiler dependencies in Node SDK output, derive proposal references from canonical registry metadata, defer URL revocation until Svelte detaches images, and fit all seven phone navigation targets without reducing their touch height.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Fixed Node bundle dependency boundaries, canonical proposal references, DOM-safe blob URL cleanup and seven-category phone layout. Local Harness guidance now requires packed cold-call acceptance, canonical fixture coverage and image replacement/unmount checks. Reused the removed-entity presenter for exact first-parent private removals without adding private units to collections.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed green ab307cb9716d796b379882f0a6c1af1f4f72c814ecaf83187e34c9cdf58410bc at f5ff44ea passes the unchanged packed consumer, seven desktop reference/lifecycle checks and mobile navigation assertion. Retired-private route pair: red d24b6ac4 at 9200a9b2, green 9f2c9eec at 3e9c0b4d; unchanged corpus passes 14 tests and records actual SSR latency and process RSS.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The sealed red commit replays the original missing compiler, filtered private identity, immediate revocation and off-screen category. Its unchanged frozen command passes after the separate source-only repair.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Pending current full verification and final task audit. All 172 active components have required own preview bindings; the initial 498-case gallery and 24 updated-control browser cases passed. Root checks passed 912 unit and 233 integration tests; package acceptance and all five lifecycle cases pass after repairing callable URLs and retired private routes. Reports and Planning checks pass; remaining workspace checks are running. Historical whole-history debt remains visible.
